page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with an x86_64 architecture, offering 32 physical cores and 64 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2794.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 43.66 GB per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with a 6144 GB SSD, and it supports premium block storage configurations.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities and memory performance. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate vector and matrix operations. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng is rated as strong, while large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaches a top-tier measurement of 367.66 GB/sec. Database operations under Passmark also achieve top-tier status, complemented by strong Redis SET throughput of 87.35 million operations per second. Large-model LLM inference benchmarks show strong prompt processing speeds, though text generation remains average.

The server represents a high-density resource profile, trading off GPU acceleration for massive memory capacity and fast local SSD storage. This makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads that require massive in-memory datasets rather than raw graphics processing. Appropriate workloads include large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and heavy data-processing pipelines that benefit from the 105 MB L3 cache and high memory bandwidth.
